biotools.summary: DISCO-variants is a tool that improves phylogenomic analyses by decomposing multi-copy gene trees into single-copy trees. It introduces DISCO-R, a refined variant, and demonstrates improved accuracy compared to other methods like ASTRAL-Pro, especially when dealing with paralogs.
